rounding: every length and height is rounded here, once, from the stages' metres to integer mm, half away from zero; nothing downstream rounds a fact again

sources.ground: the clay's carved ground (wall.py's ground_near: blender/blockouts/heart_build.py's 1.5 m grid), sampled every 100 mm at 0.7 m behind each wall's face line, where wall.py reads its bank

plan.seed: the stair kind's legacySeed (1): today's set-out, which R1 must be re-run on when 2b retires legacySeed

sources.wallFacts: wall.py's own fact draws at its seed today (1): the 1961 panel's place and length and the fall points (and which are held by cement). They are authored in code, not yet in a wl-gully record

rebuilt.cause: bulged where the lane's water ran behind it

farOnly.what: the walkable ground's nearest clear eye of each sample seen only from beyond 8 m (min, quartiles, max), and the m2 by the lane or place of that eye

method.classes: near: seen from an eye within 8 m (L0's range); farOnly: seen only from farther, up to 80 m; unseen: from nowhere within 80 m; buried: under the ground
method.eyes: the six judging views (LT1Stone.cs, in frame at 2560 x 1440) and standing eyes 1.6 m over the walkable ground: every lane, stair and quay of heart_layout.LANES every 1.75 m along and about 1.5 m across (0.3 m in from the edges), the Landing, the small places, the market square and the yards on a 1.5 m grid, none inside a house
method.faces: a sample every 220 mm along each course at its mid-height, on the face battered 1 in 6 (wall.py), 20 mm off it; a sample is buried where the ground 0.1 m outside the face stands over it
method.ground: the clay's carved ground on its 1.5 m grid (heart_layout.carve over centre_land.heights, as wall.py's ground_near), bilinear; inside each flight's clear width the steps' treads
method.measuredOn: the two-going layout's courses and copings, before any fill
method.rays: from the sample to the eye, if the eye is in front of the face; blocked by another wall line (its top as a slab 0.15 to 0.57 m outside the stair's clear half-width, under its coping's top) or by the ground (marched every 0.5 m, 20 mm under it); houses do not block (sensitivity.withHouses adds them)

withHouses.what: the houses of the clay as occluders too, each a box over its footprint to its eaves (no roof)

visibility.what: which panel faces are seen (tools/r1_elevations.py visibility): a face seen from any judging view or walkable point is laid stone by stone; a face seen from nowhere is hidden work, its fill not laid

what: R1's facts (port step 2b): the gully stair's plan and its walls' facts in integer mm, gathered by tools/r1_elevations.py facts; the laying (blender/generators/masonry.py) reads only this
